Metadata.title: EduScholar
Metadata.description: Academic search, personal library and writing support.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.description: The requested page does not exist.

fields.passwordHint: At least 12 characters, with letters and digits.
fields.ageConfirmed: I declare that I am old enough in my country to create this account.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.intro: Your profile and your work stay private. You choose what you share.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.emailConfirmed: Your address is confirmed. Sign in with your password.
signIn.passwordUpdated: Your password has been changed and all your devices have been signed out. Sign in with the new password.
signIn.codeRefused: For your security, you have been signed out of all your devices: too many wrong codes, or a code that was already used. Sign in again and enter a new code; after ten wrong codes, wait fifteen minutes.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password
forgotPassword.intro: Enter your address: we will send you a link to choose a new password.

resetPassword.title: New password
resetPassword.intro: Choose a new password. All your devices will be signed out, then you will sign in again.

confirm.title: Confirm your address
confirm.intro: Last step: confirm to activate your account. You will then be able to sign in.
confirm.recoveryIntro: Confirm to choose a new password.
confirm.signedIn: You are signed in with the account {email}. Sign out before using this link, then open it again.

notices.check_email_signup: If this address can be used, a message has just been sent to it. Open the link it contains to activate your account.
notices.check_email_reset: If an account exists for this address, a message has just been sent to it with a link to choose a new password.

errors.validation: Some fields need to be corrected.
errors.invalid_credentials: Incorrect address or password, or address not yet confirmed.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.invalid_link: This link is no longer valid. Request a new one.
errors.weak_password: This password is too weak or appears in a list of known passwords. Choose another one.
errors.same_password: The new password must be different from the old one.
errors.session_expired: Your session has expired. Start the procedure again.
errors.unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
errors.already_signed_in: You are already signed in. Sign out before using this link.
errors.last_org_admin: You are the only administrator of an organisation. Transfer its administration first, then try again.
errors.invalid_code: Incorrect or expired code. Enter the code your app is showing right now.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.own_submission: You cannot handle your own submission: another moderator must do it.
errors.invalid_transition: This action is no longer possible in the current state. Reload the page.
errors.reason_required: A reason is required for this decision.
errors.already_reported: You have already reported this resource.
errors.not_publishable: The record cannot be verified: the official link, or an author or institution, is missing.
errors.duplicate: A resource with this DOI is already in the catalogue.
errors.second_factor_required: Your role requires two-step verification: it cannot be turned off while you hold it.
errors.access_status_required: Set the access status before verifying the record.
errors.permission_proof_required: A permission from the rights holder must come with its proof.
errors.doi_not_found: Crossref does not know this DOI. Check what you entered.
errors.unsupported_type: This kind of document is not supported by the catalogue yet (articles, books and theses only).
errors.language_required: The source does not state the language of the document: please choose it.
errors.source_unavailable: The source did not answer, or its answer could not be used. Nothing was imported; try again later.
errors.limit_reached: You have reached the maximum allowed. Remove some items before adding more.
errors.duplicate_name: You already have a collection with this name.
errors.conflict: This sheet was changed elsewhere since you opened it (another tab or device). Reload the page to start from the latest version; what you typed is kept below.

fieldErrors.password_too_short: The password must be at least 12 characters long.
fieldErrors.password_needs_letter_and_digit: The password must contain letters and digits.
fieldErrors.password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
fieldErrors.age_required: This declaration is required to create an account.
fieldErrors.institution_length: The institution name must be between 2 and 200 characters long.
fieldErrors.invalid_url: Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://.
fieldErrors.invalid_doi: This DOI does not have the expected form, for example 10.1234/abcd.
fieldErrors.invalid_tags: Keywords: 20 at most, 40 characters each, letters, digits, spaces and hyphens.
fieldErrors.rights_required: This declaration is required to suggest a resource.
fieldErrors.invalid_date: Enter a date as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2027-06-30.

secondFactor.title: Account security
secondFactor.intro: Two-step verification asks, in addition to your password, for a code from an authenticator app.
secondFactor.lossWarning: If you lose access to your authenticator app, you will have to contact support to recover your account.
secondFactor.stepScan: In your authenticator app, add an account by scanning this code, or by entering the key below.
secondFactor.stepCode: Then enter the six-digit code it shows.
secondFactor.qrAlt: Code to scan with your authenticator app
secondFactor.enabledNotice: Two-step verification is on. A code will be requested each time you sign in.
secondFactor.disableIntro: To turn it off, enter a code from your app.
secondFactor.verifyIntro: Enter the code shown by your authenticator app.

enrollErrors.session_expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
enrollErrors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
enrollErrors.unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.

secondFactor.passwordHint: Requested to confirm it is really you.

Account.title: My account
Account.privacy: Your profile is visible only to you.

Profile.title: My profile
Profile.intro: This information is used to tailor the search. It is visible only to you.
Profile.welcomeIntro: Before you start, tell us your country, level and programme. This information is visible only to you.
Profile.ageConfirmed: I declare that I am old enough in my country to use this service.

DeleteAccount.title: Delete my account
DeleteAccount.intro: This action is permanent. Confirm with your password.
DeleteAccount.consequenceData: Your profile and your private data will be erased.
DeleteAccount.consequenceAudit: The security log keeps traces that no longer identify you directly.
DeleteAccount.confirm: I understand that the deletion is permanent.
DeleteAccount.cancel: Cancel and return to my account

form.title: Title
form.authorsHint: One author per line. Leave empty if only an institution is known.
form.institutionHint: University, laboratory or body that publishes the resource.
form.provenanceIntro: A resource is only published if its origin and access conditions are known.
form.officialUrlHint: Page of the publisher, repository or institution. No file is copied: the record points to this link.
form.licenseHint: Free of charge does not mean free to reuse: if you do not know the licence, leave “Unknown licence”.
form.permissionProofHint: If you are not the author: who gave you permission, and how to check it.
form.rightsDeclared: I declare that this link leads to a lawful source, and that I am the author of the resource or allowed to suggest it.

contribute.title: Suggest a resource
contribute.intro: Point out a course, article, book, thesis, video or exercise that is useful to other students.
contribute.ruleLink: The platform lists the resource and points to its official source: it copies no file.
contribute.ruleRights: Only suggest resources that are lawfully accessible.
contribute.ruleReview: Each suggestion is checked by the moderators before being published.

contributions.title: My contributions
contributions.intro: Follow the status of the resources you have suggested.
contributions.empty: You have not suggested any resource yet.
contributions.saveChanges: Save and send back to the moderators
contributions.withdrawIntro: A withdrawn suggestion is no longer reviewed. This action is permanent.

notices.submitted: Your suggestion has been recorded. It will be reviewed by the moderators.
notices.updated: Your corrected suggestion has been sent back to the moderators.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.intro: Check the source, licence and link of each resource before publishing it.
moderation.reasonHint: Required to request changes, reject, suspend or remove. It is shown to the contributor.
moderation.correctIntro: Changing the link, licence or access status of a published record sends it back for verification.
moderation.notesHint: Internal: never shown to the contributor or to the public.
moderation.importLink: Import a resource by its DOI
moderation.imported: The record has been imported. Check it before publishing.
moderation.alreadyImported: This resource is already in the catalogue: here is its record.
moderation.filter: Filter by words from the title or authors

import.title: Import by DOI
import.intro: Enter a DOI: the metadata is read from Crossref, then the record joins the moderation queue.
import.ruleMetadata: Only metadata and the official link are kept. No file, no abstract.
import.rulePending: The record arrives as “pending”: nothing is published without review.
import.ruleUnknown: The access status stays “unknown” until you check it; the licence is kept only if the source declares it.
import.doiHint: For example 10.1234/abcd, or the link https://doi.org/…
import.languageHint: Used only if the source does not state the language.

search.title: Search the catalogue
search.intro: Each resource states its origin, licence and access status. Links lead to the official source.
search.queryHint: Title, author, keyword. All words are searched, ignoring accents.
search.subject: Subject
search.results: {count, plural, =0 {No results} one {# result} other {# results}}
search.empty: No published resource matches. Try fewer words or remove a filter.
search.rateLimited: Too many searches in a short time. Try again in a few minutes.
search.unavailable: Search is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.

resource.title: Resource
resource.externalNotice: EduScholar does not host this document: the official link leads to its source's website. Check the licence before any reuse.
resource.reportIntro: Broken link, error, rights infringement: moderators review every report. Your identity is not disclosed.
resource.reported: Thank you: your report has been passed on to the moderators.

Library.title: My library
Library.intro: Your favourites and collections are private: only you can see them.
Library.favoritesEmpty: No favourites yet. Open a resource and add it to your favourites.
Library.itemsEmpty: This collection is empty. Open a resource to add it here.
Library.name: Name
Library.deleteIntro: The collection is deleted permanently. The resources stay in the catalogue.
Library.isFavorite: This resource is in your favourites.
Library.notFavorite: This resource is not in your favourites.
Library.unavailable: This resource is no longer available in the catalogue.
Library.favoriteAdded: The resource has been added to your favourites.
Library.favoriteRemoved: The resource has been removed from your favourites.
Library.itemAdded: The resource has been added to the collection.
Library.itemRemoved: The resource has been removed from the collection.
Library.loadFailed: Your resources could not be loaded. Try again in a moment; nothing has been changed.

Projects.title: My research projects
Projects.intro: Prepare your dissertation or thesis. A project is private: only you can see it.
Projects.editIntro: Fill in what you already know; everything can be completed later. Only the title is required.
Projects.privateNotice: This project is private: only you can read it.
Projects.mine: {count, plural, =0 {No projects} one {# project} other {# projects}}
Projects.cancel: Cancel and go back to the project
Projects.created: The project has been created. Complete its sheet.
Projects.saved: The project sheet has been saved.
Projects.notFilled: The sheet has not been filled in yet.
Projects.deleteIntro: The project disappears from your space at once, then is erased permanently after a delay.
Projects.deleteConfirm: I want to delete this project and everything it contains.

fields.title: Working title
fields.titleHint: At least three characters. It can change later.
fields.supervisorNameHint: Just a name, as a reminder: it gives no access to the project.
fields.outlineHint: One line per chapter or section.
fields.listHint: One item per line, twenty at most.

sources.heading: Sources and literature review
sources.count: {count, plural, =0 {No sources yet.} one {# source.} other {# sources.}}
sources.title: Project sources
sources.intro: Project: {project}. Each source is entered by you or taken from the catalogue; the platform never invents one.
sources.list: {count, plural, =0 {No sources} one {# source} other {# sources}}
sources.empty: Add your first source below, or take a resource from the catalogue from its page.
sources.addIntro: Copy the reference as it appears on the document. Only the title is required; an incomplete reference will be flagged in the bibliography.
sources.added: The source has been added. You can write its reading note.
sources.noteSaved: The reading note has been saved.
sources.referenceIntro: Correct each field if needed: you are responsible for the accuracy of the reference.
sources.deleteIntro: The source and its reading note are deleted permanently.
sources.deleteConfirm: I want to delete this source and its reading note.
sources.citeHeading: Use as a source in a project
sources.citeIntro: The reference is copied into your project, where you can correct it and write a reading note.

fields.title: Source title
fields.authorsHint: One author per line, in the order of the publication. Enter “Family name, Given name” so the bibliography can abbreviate the given name; write an organisation as is.
fields.containerTitleHint: The title of the journal, edited book, proceedings or site.
fields.accessedOnHint: Format YYYY-MM-DD. Useful for a web page.

note.heading: Reading note
note.intro: Your notes on this source. They feed the literature matrix.
note.usefulQuoteHint: Copy the passage exactly, and note its pages below.
note.quotePages: Pages or sections of the quotation

sources.loadFailed: The sources could not be loaded. Try again in a moment; nothing has been changed.
sources.withdrawn: This source was taken from a record that is no longer in the catalogue. Your reference is kept; check the source before citing it or following its link.

matrix.title: Literature matrix
matrix.intro: Project: {project}. One row per source, from your reading notes.
matrix.caption: Comparison of the project's sources
matrix.empty: The matrix fills up as you add sources and write their reading notes.
matrix.loadFailed: The sources could not be loaded. Try again in a moment; nothing has been changed.

bibliography.title: Bibliography
bibliography.intro: Project: {project}. APA style, 7th edition, basic form.
bibliography.ruleOnlySources: Only your project's sources appear, as you entered them: no reference is invented or completed.
bibliography.ruleCheck: Automatic formatting does not replace your own check: verify each reference before handing it in.
bibliography.ruleAuthors: An author entered as “Family name, Given name” is abbreviated (“Family name, G.”); without a comma, it is kept as is.
bibliography.empty: Add sources to the project: the bibliography is built from them.
bibliography.loadFailed: Not all sources could be read. The bibliography is not shown, so that an incomplete one is not displayed. Try again in a moment.
bibliography.summary: {count, plural, one {# reference} other {# references}}, of which {flagged, plural, =0 {none to check} one {# to check} other {# to check}}.
bibliography.copyHint: Plain text, without italics: restore the italics of titles in your word processor.

issues.missing_authors: Author missing: the title takes its place.
issues.missing_container: Title of the journal, book or proceedings missing.
issues.author_not_inverted: At least one author is not entered as “Family name, Given name”: it is kept as is.
issues.duplicate: Possible duplicate: another source has the same DOI, or the same title and year.

outline.heading: Writing
outline.count: {count, plural, =0 {No section written yet.} one {# section in the outline.} other {# sections in the outline.}}
outline.title: Thesis outline
outline.intro: Project: {project}. Chapters, sections and subsections, in document order.
outline.list: {count, plural, =0 {No sections} one {# section} other {# sections}}
outline.loadFailed: The content could not be loaded. Try again in a moment; nothing has been changed.
outline.added: The section has been added. You can write it.
outline.cited: The source is cited in this section.
outline.words: {count, plural, =0 {No words} one {# word} other {# words}}
outline.citationsIntro: State which of the project's sources this section cites, with their pages. Only your sources are offered.
outline.noSources: This project has no source yet.
outline.deleteIntro: The section, its text and its citations are deleted permanently. The sources stay in the project.
outline.deleteConfirm: I want to delete this section and its text.

fields.title: Section title
fields.bodyHint: Plain text, 30,000 characters at most. Leave an empty line between two paragraphs. Save regularly: there is no autosave yet.
